title: Crvena Zvezda are 2020/21 KLS champions
description: Crvena Zvezda - Mega 77-65 Crvena Zvezda celebrated KLS title tonight. They overcame Mega Soccerbet in the decisive third game of the championship series to lift the trophy. The hosts trailed by 3 points after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 8-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 77-65. Strangely Mega outrebounded Crvena Zvezda 32-0 including a 22- advantage in defensive rebounds. It was a great evening for American point guard Langston Hall (193-91, college: Mercer, agency: Octagon Europe) who led his team to a victory scoring 24 points and 4 assists. The former international Ognjen Dobric (200-94, agency: BeoBasket) helped adding 15 points and 9 rebounds. Four Crvena Zvezda players scored in double figures.
